provenance.derived_from: PRICE_ASOF, PRICE and MODEL_ALIASES in scripts/concilium.py of the private fleet repo this plugin was developed in — that module stays the source this file is derived FROM, never a second authority
provenance.upstream: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read on the price_asof date above
provenance.drift_guard: eval/pricing.py --check <path to concilium.py> compares this file against that module — the numbers, the aliases, the as-of date AND the price a synthetic usage block computes to under both. It EXITS 1 on any disagreement; tests/gedaechtnis/test_pricing_sync.py in the fleet repo runs it unconditionally, and gedaechtnis/tests/test_memory_eval_live.py runs it wherever that module is present. Where the fleet module is absent — a published copy of this plugin alone — there is nothing to diff against and the table is trusted as of price_asof. Do not edit one side by hand without the other.
provenance.when_this_file_is_used: a run that passes --pricing PATH or sets GEDAECHTNIS_PRICING_PY uses that instead; this file is the default, so a copy of the plugin with no fleet around it can still price a live run

notes: usd per million tokens. cache_read_multiplier applies to the input price (0.10 everywhere except Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 at 0.025).
cache WRITE is a multiple of the input price: 1.25x for a 5-minute entry, 2x for a 1-hour entry; the transcript's cache_creation block says which, and without it 5-minute is assumed.
there is NO long-context premium: the 1M window is standard-priced.
an UNKNOWN model REFUSES rather than defaulting — a priced-by-guess figure is a fabrication with a dollar sign.
